# Learning Platforms Via Your Library Card

_3 offer(s). Part of The Actually-Free Job Training Directory; go [back to the index](../index.md)._

Public libraries (and state libraries) in the US often pay for huge learning platforms, then hand them to cardholders at no charge. You may already be paying for these locally, so this is the closest thing to money-for-nothing in the directory.

| Offer | Provider | What free means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Gale Courses](#entry-gale-courses) | Gale (Cengage) via public libraries | Free through participating public libraries: your card number (plus a free learner account) is tuition |
| [Universal Class](#entry-universal-class) | Universal Class via public libraries | Free through thousands of participating public libraries; card number is tuition |
| [LearningExpress Library](#entry-learningexpress) | EBSCO via public/state libraries | Free through participating libraries; card number is the pass |

<a id="entry-gale-courses"></a>

### Gale Courses

**Provider:** Gale (Cengage) via public libraries  
**Link:** <https://www.gale.com/c/galecourses>

**What it is:** Six-week, instructor-led courses on job and life skills: business writing, grant writing, computers, healthcare-related workplace skills, personal finance.

**What "free" means:** Free through participating public libraries: your card number (plus a free learner account) is tuition. New sessions start monthly.

**Paper trail:** Free certificate of completion for finishing quizzes/assignments.

**Time needed:** 2-4 hours per week for 6 weeks, with instructors available

**Honest catch:** Only works if your local library subscribes (check the library chooser inside the product). Course material can feel slightly dated.

**Tags:** library-card, certificate, instructor-led, career

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-universal-class"></a>

### Universal Class

**Provider:** Universal Class via public libraries  
**Link:** <https://www.universalclass.com>

**What it is:** 500+ online courses across office skills, computers, care work, office administration, and 'How-Tos for jobs' with real human-paced lessons.

**What "free" means:** Free through thousands of participating public libraries; card number is tuition. Courses include CEUs (Continuing Education Units) from an IACET-recognized provider at no cost through the library.

**Paper trail:** Course certificate and CEU documentation for most courses.

**Time needed:** Per-course: usually 8-20 hours, up to 6 months to finish

**Honest catch:** Library-sponsor access usually caps you at a handful of concurrent courses. CEUs are continuing-education units, not college credit.

**Tags:** library-card, ceu, certificate, self-paced

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-learningexpress"></a>

### LearningExpress Library

**Provider:** EBSCO via public/state libraries  
**Link:** <https://www.learningexpresshub.com>

**What it is:** Practice exams and course videos for job-track certification tests: civil service, nursing school entry, CDL (commercial driver), cosmetology, and high-school equivalency (GED/HiSET).

**What "free" means:** Free through participating libraries; card number is the pass. Includes course videos, e-books, and full practice-test banks.

**Paper trail:** Scores and progress only. The actual credential comes if you pass the real-world exam this prepares you for.

**Time needed:** Per-exam track: often 10-40 hours of practice

**Honest catch:** Institutional access only: you need a library that subscribes. Exam content is study material, not instruction in a skilled trade.

**Tags:** library-card, exam-prep, no-signup, career

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08
